strategies: Answer-producing actions use only displayed choice position or choice bank; no generator metadata or prompt arithmetic. Ties break by first displayed choice.
conclusion: All six tested bank-only strategies succeed once per five in each controlled recognizable sign/factor subgroup, before and after delivery. All five answer-bearing roles can be correct with the same visible bank and subgroup. This refutes deterministic bank-only predictors for these controlled banks. Fresh-sample rates are descriptive, not an absence-of-shortcuts proof; very small runner subgroups are not used to infer a defect.
